升级增加2伤和1回合易伤；按其他易伤来源与实际联动评估，不作为默认关键升级。: Upgrade adds 2 damage and 1 turn of Vulnerable. Value depends on other Vulnerable sources and synergies; not a default priority upgrade.
零费输出；复制导致的战斗内膨胀尚未模拟。: Zero-cost damage. In-combat deck growth from copies is not simulated.
群体易伤；当前尚不按具体敌人估值。: Applies Vulnerable to all enemies; specific enemy matchups are not modeled.
一费两段共10伤（升级14）；降低过渡先验，保留真实双段力量收益，不作为默认力量: Two hits for 10 damage (14 upgraded), costing 1. Reduced early-pick value; retains actual Strength scaling, but is not a default Strength core.
升级多抽1张；同回合禁抽限制使多张互相冲突。: Upgrade draws 1 more. The same-turn draw restriction makes multiple copies conflict.
固定力量持续本战，但不逐回合成长；按现有力量来源、阶段和重复张数评估。: Adds fixed Strength for this combat, not per-turn growth. Evaluated by existing Strength, run stage and copies.
抽二放回一，净手牌不增加；零费整理与自替换。升级后不消耗。: Draw 2, put 1 back: no net hand gain. Zero-cost selection and replacement; upgrade removes Exhaust.
付一得三，净产两费；需要先有一费启动。: Spend 1 to gain 3 energy: net +2, requiring 1 energy to start.
自动打出攻击的费用利用依赖牌组；不直接生成能量。: Energy savings from auto-playing Attacks depend on the deck; it does not directly generate energy.
X费自动打出抽牌堆顶部的牌，不等于直接抽入手牌；顺序、目标和负面牌有风险。: X-cost auto-play from the draw pile is not drawing into hand. Order, targets and harmful cards create risk.
消耗堆至少三张才能造成群伤；本身不提供消耗手段。: Needs at least 3 exhausted cards for area damage; does not enable Exhaust itself.
格挡引擎组件，按实际格挡来源估值。: Block-engine component, valued against actual Block sources.
两次伤害后随机消耗手中攻击，继承单次伤害；可能吞掉关键攻击。: Hits twice, then randomly exhausts an Attack in hand and inherits its damage per hit. May consume a key Attack.
自伤成长须有实际触发来源，不作为无条件力量。: Self-damage scaling requires actual triggers; not unconditional Strength.
高数值过渡攻击，缺输出时仍有价值；不当成长核心。: High immediate damage can fill an early damage gap; not a scaling engine.
高数值过渡防御，仍可支撑格挡体系。: High immediate Block with potential Block synergy.
未升级时的随机消耗存在不稳定性。: Random Exhaust before upgrading makes results less reliable.
消耗其他手牌并生成等量随机战士牌；不等于从牌库抽牌，也不提供能量。可能损失手中的: Exhausts the other cards in hand and generates that many random Ironclad cards. Neither draws from the deck nor grants energy. May lose key cards; generated value is approximate.
回收关键牌的价值仍采用粗略先验。: Retrieving key cards still uses a rough prior.
伤害取决于出牌时格挡，不能按固定伤害理解。: Damage depends on Block when played, not a fixed damage value.
消耗其余手牌，按消耗张数多段攻击；手牌量和留下的关键牌决定价值。: Exhausts the rest of the hand for multiple hits. Hand size and the value of consumed cards matter.
格挡触发伤害，依赖格挡次数而非单次格挡数值。: Damage triggers on gaining Block: number of triggers matters more than Block per trigger.
技能消耗引擎；长战耗尽技能的代价尚未模拟。: Skill-Exhaust engine. Running out of Skills in long fights is not simulated.
需要稳定产出格挡，启动成本较高。: Needs reliable Block generation and has a high setup cost.
慢速成长，短战的启动代价较高。: Slow scaling with a high setup cost in short fights.
最大生命成长按先验估计，不保证每场都能触发。: Max HP growth is estimated, not guaranteed each fight.
X 费群攻按粗略能力标签估值。: X-cost area damage uses approximate feature-based valuation.
三费32点集中伤害；升级42，免费施放与额外打出另计。: 32 focused damage for 3 energy (42 upgraded); free and additional plays evaluated separately.
收益取决于每回合打出的攻击数量。: Value depends on Attacks played each turn.
敌人易伤时攻击两次；额外收益按牌组易伤来源估计。: Hits twice against Vulnerable enemies; bonus estimated from the deck's Vulnerable sources.
一费三层易伤，自身消耗；按高效易伤覆盖和主宰等实际联动评价，痛击不视为同质量替代: 3 Vulnerable for 1 energy, then Exhaust. Valued for efficient coverage and real synergies such as Dominate; Bash is not an equivalent substitute.
仅被消耗时获得能量，不能按打出即回能估值。: Grants energy only when exhausted, not when played.
之后两回合无法获得格挡；已下调即时格挡收益。: Prevents Block gain for the next two turns; immediate Block value is discounted.
仅剩此牌时才能抽牌回能；触发率暂按低先验。: Draw and energy require this to be the only card in hand; conservative trigger estimate.
消耗手牌而非抽牌。: Exhausts cards in hand; does not draw.
补满手牌按近似收益估计。: Refilling the hand uses an approximate value.
减力量的防御收益取决于敌人行动。: Defensive value of Strength reduction depends on enemy actions.
反伤价值依赖敌人攻击频率。: Retaliation value depends on enemy attack frequency.
手中只能有攻击牌的限制显著降低可用性。: Requiring only Attacks in hand greatly limits usability.
随机生成技能不等同于稳定抽牌。: Randomly generated Skills are not reliable card draw.
复制攻击或能力，收益依赖具体目标。: Copies an Attack or Power; value depends on the target.
翻倍现有格挡，需要格挡引擎支持。: Doubles existing Block; needs a Block engine.
持续生成随机普通牌可能稀释运转。: Repeatedly generating random Common cards may dilute the deck.
能量在下一回合获得，已折扣延迟和空转风险。: Energy arrives next turn; delay and wasted-energy risks are discounted.
下一张牌回牌库顶的价值依赖出牌顺序。: Putting the next card on top depends on play order.
格挡取决于弃牌堆，首轮价值偏低。: Block depends on the discard pile; lower value in the first cycle.
诅咒/状态牌按负担处理；特殊联动未计入。: Curses and Statuses are treated as burdens; special synergies are excluded.
已估计此附魔收益；首次触发效果按一次计算。: This enchantment's value is estimated; first-trigger effects count once.
附魔/异变已记录，当前仅评价基础能力及实际费用，额外效果未计分。: Enchantment/affliction recorded. Only base effects and actual cost are valued; additional effects are unscored.
基础数据已登记；通用近似评价，条件触发及特殊机制尚未全部建模。: Base data registered. Generic approximation; conditional and special mechanics are not fully modeled.
后续已知可达商店 {0}，未来幕 {1}；兑现系数 {2}: Known reachable shops: {0}; future acts: {1}; realization factor: {2}
无已知商店不计确定金币收益；污浊战斗中也会伤害玩家，不按免费群伤估值。无可靠去处: No guaranteed gold value without a known shop. Foul Potion also harms the player in combat; it is not free area damage. Do not discard existing potions for it without a reliable destination.
金币不足，不能自动执行。: Not enough gold for automatic execution.
随机升级期望（非确定预测）: Expected random upgrade value (not a certain prediction)
变化低效牌的先验: Prior value of transforming weak cards
空药水栏收益: Value of filling empty potion slots
点评作为条件假设；分数为人工先验，尚未经过跨种子胜率校准。: Feedback is used as a conditional hypothesis. Scores are manual priors, not calibrated cross-seed win rates.
只将已核验的副本预测称为确定结果；未预测的随机收益按期望和风险计分。: Only verified cloned-state previews are treated as certain; other random rewards use expected value and risk.
事件战斗采用保守战损先验；尚未调用整场试战。: Event combat uses conservative damage estimates; no full combat trial has been run.
最大生命先增加再扣血；每次泡浴后按递增伤害重新判断。: Gain Max HP before losing HP; reassess increasing damage after each bath.
限时伤害考验，未证明三回合击破时降低最高档奖励兑现率。: Timed damage challenge: discount the highest reward unless victory within three turns is established.
孵化消耗营火机会，并在孵化前占用牌组。: Hatching consumes a rest-site opportunity and occupies the deck until then.
跨角色奖励仅在原生允许跳过时放弃，不伪造跳过。: Off-character rewards are skipped only if the native game allows it; no artificial skip.
常态限制出牌；不能仅把两次删牌减一次诅咒等同无负面删一张。: A persistent play restriction: two removals plus a Curse are not simply one free removal.
需要读取交换两端的实际遗物。: Must read the actual relics on both sides of the exchange.
需要读取实际待移除卡牌。: Must read the actual card to be removed.
石中剑须再击败五场精英才变成加力量的玉石剑；当前没有即时战力。未证明能完成五场前: The sword needs five more Elite victories to become the Strength-granting Jade Sword; no immediate combat gain. Discount its future value until achievable; taking gold still accounts for HP risk.
生命上限较低时，扣除超过12%上限的额外长期风险: Extra long-term risk when low Max HP makes the loss exceed 12% of Max HP
愧疚在五场战斗后自动移除；普通血量、长路线优先兑现永久删牌收益。: Guilty disappears after five fights. With ordinary HP and a long route, favor permanent removal value.
临时占抽牌估值 {0}；低于40%血量时提高近期负担，剩余不超过五层时不预支到期: Temporary draw burden: {0}; higher near-term burden below 40% HP. With at most five floors left, do not assume expiry. Uncalibrated policy, not a damage forecast.
无休之处：非紧急且恢复不足最大生命65%，降低拿保留诅咒回血的偏好: Restless site: when not urgent and healing is below 65% of Max HP, reduce preference for healing with a retaining Curse
65%是用户指定的策略门槛，不是原生机制或已验证最优阈值。睡眠不佳会保留占手；后: 65% is the author's policy threshold, not a game rule or proven optimum. The Curse retains and occupies the hand; reaching a later rest site safely is not guaranteed.
原生限定多人卡；单人战士不按队友收益推荐。: Native multiplayer-only card; no teammate value recommended for solo Ironclad.
原始力量生成的一费20伤（升级24伤）攻击；无永久成长。: Attack generated by Primal Force: 20 damage for 1 energy (24 upgraded); no permanent scaling.
每回合从弃牌堆随机回收并升级攻击；首回合和无攻击弃牌时空转。: Randomly retrieves and upgrades an Attack from discard each turn; no payoff on turn one or without discarded Attacks.
6+消耗堆张数×3（升级×4）；另计实际消耗来源，非固定6伤。: 6 + 3 per exhausted card (4 upgraded); actual Exhaust sources are evaluated separately.
两费自伤格挡；低血时仍计自伤风险。: Two-energy Block with self-damage; HP risk remains at low health.
高伤加易伤；本卡为特殊获得牌，按实际费用评价。: High damage plus Vulnerable. Special-source card valued using its actual cost.
群攻自伤；群体收益采用保守折扣。: Area attack with self-damage; conservative area-value discount.
零费，按目标易伤层数成长；易伤来源另计。: Zero cost, scaling with target Vulnerable stacks; sources evaluated separately.
攻击后随机消耗一张手牌；保留误烧关键牌风险。: Attacks, then randomly exhausts a card in hand; retains risk of consuming a key card.
本回合来自易伤敌人的攻击减半；不是无条件全伤害减半。: Halves attacks from Vulnerable enemies this turn; not unconditional damage reduction.
群体多段伤害；多段受力量支撑。: Multiple hits to all enemies; supported by Strength.
每回合自伤并获得格挡；长期收益与生命成本并存。: Self-damage and Block each turn: ongoing value comes with an HP cost.
提高易伤倍率；必须有可兑现的易伤及攻击。: Increases the Vulnerable multiplier; needs usable Vulnerable and Attacks.
先给予易伤，再按目标易伤层数获得力量；不等同零收益消耗技能。: Applies Vulnerable, then gains Strength based on the target's stacks; not a zero-value exhausting Skill.
本回合已消耗牌时格挡两次；条件收益单列。: Gains Block twice if a card was exhausted this turn; conditional value tracked separately.
格挡随当前力量增加；三费启动，不能预设已有高力量。: Block scales with current Strength. Costs 3; do not assume high Strength already exists.
双段并获得力量，同时给敌人力量；危险代价另计。: Two hits and Strength, but also grants enemy Strength; danger priced separately.
免费打出牌库顶并强制消耗；需要排序或高费目标，随机烧关键牌有风险。: Auto-plays the top card for free and exhausts it. Needs ordering or expensive targets; risks consuming a key card.
抽到打击标签牌时自动打出；不能把所有攻击都当成打击。: Auto-plays drawn Strike-tagged cards; not all Attacks count as Strikes.
在消耗堆中每回合自动施放；必须先有把它送入消耗堆的手段。: Auto-plays each turn from Exhaust; needs a way to exhaust it first.
随机攻击当回合免费；随机质量折扣，不算稳定过牌。: A random Attack is free this turn; discount random quality, not reliable draw.
每回合自伤，回合内失血触发群伤；计为真实自伤来源。: Self-damage each turn; HP loss during the turn triggers area damage. Counts as a real self-damage source.
每回合第三张攻击复制入手；仍需费用，不是立即抽牌。: Copies the third Attack each turn into hand. Still needs energy; not immediate draw.
攻击并暂时大幅减力量；三费防攻一体，不能当永久减力量。: Attacks and sharply reduces Strength temporarily. Costs 3; not permanent Strength reduction.
一费10伤（升级14），自身消耗；攻击后才翻倍已有易伤，不凭空施加第一层易伤，也: 10 damage for 1 energy (14 upgraded), then Exhaust. Doubles existing Vulnerable after attacking; neither applies the first stack nor exhausts other weak cards.
战中治疗，按缺血与未来战损机会估计，不能当作当前已回血。: In-combat healing estimated by missing HP and future damage opportunities; not HP already restored.
使接下来的攻击额外打出；升级影响两张，需高质量攻击和可用费用。: Makes upcoming Attacks play again (two when upgraded); needs good Attacks and available energy.
按战斗牌组的打击标签数量增伤；删打击会减弱，动态计数。: Damage scales with Strike-tagged cards in the combat deck; removing Strikes reduces it. Counted dynamically.
持续抽攻击直到首张非攻击；收益由攻击密度决定。: Draws Attacks until the first non-Attack; value depends on Attack density.
将手中攻击变为巨石；前期提升基础攻击，成熟核心被替换也有损失。: Turns Attacks in hand into Boulders. Improves basic Attacks early, but may replace strong core cards later.
以后每回合获得能量；不是打出当回合回费，启动已折扣。: Energy on future turns, not the turn played; setup discounted.
重复打出才增加本卡伤害；循环速度和竞争攻击限制成长。: This card's damage grows only through repeated plays; cycling speed and competing Attacks limit growth.
力量只持续本回合；不计为持续成长，需后续攻击兑现。: Strength lasts only this turn; no persistent scaling, and later Attacks must use it.
本回合失血时才多段；未满足时只攻击一次。: Multiple hits only if HP was lost this turn; otherwise one hit.
本回合每打出攻击减一费；按攻击密度折扣启动费用。: Costs 1 less per Attack played this turn; setup discounted by Attack density.
覆甲持续产防，但被破防会衰减；不计无限稳定防御。: Plating generates Block but decays when breached; not unlimited reliable defense.
格挡并给予易伤；与现有易伤功能存在重复。: Block plus Vulnerable; overlaps with existing Vulnerable sources.
按本战失血次数增加攻击次数；自伤源比盲目挨打可靠。: Hits scale with times HP was lost this combat; self-damage is more reliable than taking enemy hits.
下一张攻击免费；按牌组中其他高费攻击评价费用收益。: Makes the next Attack free; value depends on other expensive Attacks.
施加易伤触发抽牌；触发密度另计，不是无条件每回合抽牌。: Applying Vulnerable triggers draw; evaluated by trigger density, not unconditional draw each turn.
生成药水；受药水空位、使用节奏和添水遗物约束。: Generates a potion; limited by empty slots, usage pace and potion-altering relics.
从牌库检索稀有牌；需足够金卡，不能把普通牌当抽牌目标。: Searches the deck for Rare cards; needs enough Rares, not Common targets.
每抽十张才获得能量；随过牌频率估值。: Energy only after every ten cards drawn; valued by draw frequency.
从弃牌堆自动打出数张攻击；首轮可能无目标，高费攻击支撑收益。: Auto-plays several Attacks from discard. May have no first-cycle targets; expensive Attacks improve value.
打出后下回合回手；零费但低单卡质量。: Returns to hand next turn after playing. Zero cost, but low individual impact.
攻击后生成随机攻击；三费启动和生成牌费用限制收益。: Attacks, then generates a random Attack; 3-energy setup and generated-card costs limit value.
从抽牌堆随机自动打出多张牌，优先可打出牌；不生成攻击。: Randomly auto-plays several cards from the draw pile, favoring playable cards; does not generate Attacks.
三选一生成当回合免费牌；升级可重复，随机池不等于已有牌库。: Choose one of three generated cards, free this turn; reusable when upgraded. The random pool is not your deck.
固有零费群攻；占首回合手牌，后续不循环。: Innate zero-cost area attack; uses an opening-hand slot and does not cycle afterward.
每回合可变化手牌；能处理废牌，但替换结果随机。: Can transform cards in hand each turn; handles weak cards, but replacements are random.
格挡并保留手牌一回合，帮助排序，也可能堵手。: Block and one-turn hand retention help sequencing but may clog the hand.
高费覆甲；回合收益会随破防衰减。: Expensive Plating; per-turn value declines when Block is breached.
提高防御标签牌格挡；不是对所有防御技能生效。: Improves Defend-tagged cards, not every defensive Skill.
按造成伤害获得格挡；力量、易伤提高攻防，格挡需求不同步折扣。: Block based on damage dealt; Strength and Vulnerable improve both. Discount when defense is not needed at the same time.
伤害随本战打牌次数增长；早抽低收益，按运转速度估计。: Damage grows with cards played this combat; low value when drawn early, estimated by cycling speed.
致死赚金币；剩余可消费路线决定经济价值，不保证每战收割。: Gold on a kill; remaining spending opportunities determine value. A kill each fight is not guaranteed.
随机赋予抽牌堆一张牌额外打出；需要再次抽到并打出。: Gives a random draw-pile card an additional play; must draw and play it again.
手中无攻击才能抽牌；攻击密集时严格折扣。: Draw requires no Attacks in hand; heavily discounted in Attack-heavy decks.
随机生成无色牌，不是抽牌；需支付生成牌费用。: Generates a random Colorless card, not a draw; generated card still costs energy.
生成零费牌可帮助续打；三费起手负担仍存在。: Generated zero-cost cards can extend a turn; the 3-energy setup remains a burden.
每回合自动打出牌库顶；有免费高费收益及顺序/误打风险。: Auto-plays the top card each turn; potential free expensive cards, with ordering and unwanted-play risks.
固有，伤害取决于剩余抽牌堆；按牌组大小估计首轮收益。: Innate; damage depends on remaining draw-pile size. Opening value estimated by deck size.
首批攻击/技能回到牌库顶；回收核心与堵住下一抽并存。: First Attacks/Skills return to the top; can retrieve core cards or obstruct the next draw.
零费伤害向其他敌人扩散；群体收益按保守系数。: Zero-cost damage spreads to other enemies; area value conservatively discounted.
一回合打五张才群伤；依赖低费和运转。: Area damage requires five plays in one turn; depends on low costs and cycling.
每回合给予活力；优先配合高质量、多段攻击。: Vigor each turn; favors strong multi-hit Attacks.
零费产费，按过牌及费用需求评价。: Zero-cost energy, valued by draw and energy needs.
把当前格挡用于下回合；必须先有可观格挡，非即时防御。: Carries current Block into next turn; requires substantial Block first, not immediate defense.
获得力量与敏捷；收益取决于攻击和格挡触发频率。: Strength and Dexterity; value depends on Attack and Block trigger frequency.
按目标非临时负面效果种类加伤；不能按易伤层数加伤。: Damage per distinct non-temporary debuff on the target, not per Vulnerable stack.
